deviations_from_card: REVISION applied: the Windows remedy names both the Settings switch and re-allowing at Athena's own microphone prompt (no 'webview' word in the sentence; the WebView2 reason is in the ADR), with a case asserting both. fixtures.ts, readiness.test.ts and model.test.ts unchanged (new cases live in mic.test.ts / mic-hook.test.tsx). Added SetupModel.micRemedy (optional source field, default '') so micFact's denied summary is the remedy alone while micDetail is remedy + the browser's words in parentheses; on arrival micDetail is the remedy too, because Mind's Microphone level draws micDetail, not micFact. The hook is first-frame code (console/scenes.tsx statically imports mind/live and waking/live), so mic.ts is reached only via import(): a first in-hook version measured +473 B (over the ceiling) and was reworked; mic.ts gained followMic/answerOf so the hook carries only the effect. Two commits collapsed into one. ADR is 0221 (0215-0220 taken).
